messages:
mike-acct: Heads up — Acme POC needs a short capacity bump for a customer-facing demo next Thurs 10:00 -> Fri 10:00 UTC (24h). They plan sustained ~350 RPS for chat generation. Current Dedicated pool is poc-acme-qa (max 6 instances, burst x2). Can we coordinate a temporary autoscale override and give a fast cost delta and checklist? They want to avoid spinning up a VPC for the demo.

rachel-se: FYI: pool poc-acme-qa: min=2, max=6, burst_multiplier=2. Two immediate options: 1) temporary override -> max=10, burst=3 for the 24h window + pre-warm 2) migrate to a pre-warmed pool set to 10 for that day. Both need capacity-ops approval. Estimated infra delta: ~$900$1.2k for 24h depending on GPU class (g6 vs g7), includes burst premium.

sam-capacity: easiest is to schedule an override. Use admin CLI or submit a capacity request. Example CLI: 
```
/admin/pools schedule-override --pool poc-acme-qa --start 2026-04-09T10:00:00Z --end 2026-04-10T10:00:00Z --max-instances 10 --burst-mult 3 --note "Acme demo 24h"
```
I'll need the approved CR to push it. If you want pre-warm, we usually allocate it 2h before start.

toni-security: Security checks if we do hosted/API approach (no VPC):
- scoped API key for POC with IP allowlist (customer IPs + our CI).
- KMS enabled for their customer encryption keys if they require key control.
- Audit logs: we can stream event summaries (calls, latencies, errors); they asked NOT to include raw token payloads.
- Short-lived keys and rotation window for the demo.

acme-contact: Confirming: we do not want a Private/VPC for the demo. IP allowlist + scoped key + audit extract is fine. Also would like a one-line test they can run once keys are live.

rachel-se: For the quick pricing: Lina in Billing usually provides exact line items but rough calc: additional 4 instances * 24h at on-demand (~$0.8k) + burst premium + pre-warm ~ total ~$900$1.2k. If this becomes a recurring weekly demo we should talk reserved commit discount.

ops-bot: capacity-request #CR-501 created (poc-acme-qa override). Assigned: sam-capacity. Approval ETA: 0h.

sam-capacity: I'll attach the pre-warm plan to CR-501 and set pre-warm to 2h before the window. Fallback plan if denied: route a subset of traffic to hosted model variant with slightly higher latency (doc url: https://internal.redwood/poc-fallbacks).

mike-acct: Action list: 1) sam-capacity -> push CR-501 and pre-warm 2) rachel-se -> confirm final cost line items (cc billing) 3) toni-security -> send minimal audit sample + key rotation steps 4) ops-bot -> post when override is applied.

acme-contact: Please include the one-line curl test and a sample audit entry we can validate.

toni-security: sample curl we will provide once key is ready. Sample minimal audit entry: timestamp, request_id, model, latency_ms, status_code. No prompt/response text included.

rachel-se: I'll pull the exact instance-hour pricing and post a quick breakdown in ~90m.

sam-capacity: noted. I'll update CR-501 with the schedule and tag capacity-ops reviewers.

mike-acct: Thanks team 44D — please keep this channel updated when CR moves to approved and when keys are issued.
